name: GATE ME Mechanical Engineering Mock - Chapter Test

questions.question: What is the main purpose of annealing in metals?
options: Soften the metal & relieve internal stress
questions.hint: Annealing involves heating and slow cooling to soften grains and reduce internal stress.

questions.question: Which thermodynamic cycle forms the basis of petrol engines?
questions.hint: The Otto cycle describes constant-volume combustion in spark-ignition engines.

questions.question: The COP of a refrigerator is always:
questions.hint: COP = Q_low / W_in, which can be less than, equal to, or greater than 1 depending on operating temps.

questions.question: For a fluid at rest, the shear stress is:
questions.hint: By definition, fluids at rest cannot support shear stress.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure fluid velocity at a point?
questions.hint: Pitot tubes measure local velocity by converting kinetic energy to pressure head.

questions.question: A beam fixed at one end and free at the other is called:
questions.hint: A cantilever beam has one rigid built-in support and a free projecting end.

questions.question: Which theory of failure is best suited for ductile materials?
questions.hint: Maximum shear stress theory provides reliable yields boundaries for ductile metals.

questions.question: The thermal efficiency of a Carnot engine depends only on:
What type of stress is induced in a shaft transmitting torque?
questions.hint: Torque transmission causes shearing across circular cross-sectional planes.

questions.question: The ratio of lateral strain to longitudinal strain is:
questions.hint: Poisson's ratio measures structural transverse deformation behavior.

questions.question: What is the primary mechanism of heat transfer in solid metals?
questions.hint: Conduction transfers kinetic heat energy via free electrons and lattice vibrations.

questions.question: Which governor is classified as a dead-weight governor?
questions.hint: The Porter governor adds a central heavy dead-weight on the sleeve to increase sensitivity.

questions.question: For maximum transmission of power through a nozzle, the fluid speed should be:
questions.hint: Maximum nozzle fluid power transmission occurs when friction loss equals one-third of inlet head.

questions.question: Which casting defect occurs due to low pouring temperature of liquid metal?
questions.hint: A cold shut is a seam formed when two streams of liquid metal fail to fuse due to premature freezing.

questions.question: The kinematic viscosity of a fluid is defined as:
options: Product of density and dynamic viscosity
